title: skills: objectstack-ui still teaches internal create and edit forms, and not showOnCreate (after #36425)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36425 (PR #36449, then its PR 2). PR #36449 declares `Skills-docs: follow-up owed`, and skills text may change only in a domain:skills PR, so it gets its own card. Filed by the seat. Parent: #36425.

## What happens

`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` (around lines 44 to 54) and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` (Form Views) teach the object's internal create and edit forms. Card #36425 retires those forms for create and edit and adds the field key `showOnCreate`. After both PRs merge, an agent that follows the skill still writes an internal create form that nothing loads, and never sets `showOnCreate`.

## To do

1. Teach that an object's create and edit surfaces are built from its fields and field groups, and that `showOnCreate: false` leaves a field out of every create surface. A required field cannot turn it off.
2. Keep the teaching for a form an action opens by name (action type `form`, `/forms/:name`): those still load.
3. Keep public forms as they are taught today.

## Acceptance

- The two skill files teach the create surfaces as #36425's PR 2 lands them, and no sentence teaches an internal create or edit form as live.

Blocked-by: #36449 and #36425's PR 2

## Grade
p2 · domain:skills. Teaching drift once the card lands.
